decision.explanation: The question asks for the release date of 'The Last of Us Part II'. Source D3S2 explicitly states 'Release Date: June 19, 2020' in the context of 'The Last of Us Part II', which aligns with the real-world release date of the game. Source D1S2 states 'Release Date: June 9, 2010', but this date is factually incorrect for 'The Last of Us Part II' (which was released in 2020) and likely refers to a different entity or is an error in the source text (the first game was released in 2013, not 2010). Given the instruction to treat sources as fallible and resolve contradictions based on context, 'June 19, 2020' is the only valid answer supported by the specific context of the game's actual release. 'June 9, 2010' is rejected as it contradicts the known facts and the specific context of the game title provided in the other source.
